name: GR00T N1
summary: GR00T N1 couples a vision-language module (System 2, ~10 Hz) with a diffusion-transformer action module (System 1, up to 120 Hz), trained jointly end to end. Its distinguishing bet is the data pyramid: a small base of real teleoperation, a large layer of simulation and neurally generated trajectories, and a huge layer of egocentric human video, unified through learned latent actions so unlabeled video can still supervise the policy.
innovation: Latent-action learning lets human video without action labels train a robot policy.
Explicit dual-system architecture with different clock rates, trained end to end rather than stitched together.
Open weights plus the synthetic-data pipeline and simulator that produced the training set.
matters: The most complete open humanoid manipulation stack: model, data engine and simulator together.
limits: Heavily tied to NVIDIA's simulation ecosystem; real-world evaluation breadth is narrower than pi-0's.
lineage: A pi-0-style VLM plus action expert, extended with latent actions and a synthetic data pipeline.
